title: Judge orders OpenAI to turn over hiring records in Apple trade secrets case
summary: A federal judge ruled that Apple can access OpenAI's interview materials involving former Apple employees, as well as private messages and testimony from key figures in the case.
reason: Court order in a private trade-secrets lawsuit between Apple and OpenAI is litigation, not a new model release, research artifact, industry business event (financing/M&A/partnership/revenue/product launch), policy/regulatory action, or OSS tool. No active rule covers it.
